# viettelcloud_volume_backup (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud volume backup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "volume_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "viettelcloud_volume_backup" "example" {
  name        = "example-volume-backup"
  description = "Daily recovery point"
  volume      = { id = var.volume_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Backup name.
- `volume` (Attributes) Source volume. Changing it replaces the backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Backup description. Omit it to preserve the current value. Set an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `disk_type` (String) Source disk type.
- `encryption_key_size` (String) Encryption key size.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the backup expired.
- `id` (String) Backup ID (UUID).
- `policy_id` (String) Backup policy ID (UUID), if any.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `size` (Number) Backup size in GiB.
- `status` (String) Current backup status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `volume_name` (String) Source volume name.

<a id="nestedatt--volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume`

Required:

- `id` (String) Volume ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_volume_backup.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
